_documentation.purpose: Create an interpretable early-time nested-mesh reference: one centered vortex and one stationary laser on a 150 nm square film with 1 nm reference spacing.
_documentation.relies_on: configs/simulations/nbn_optical_vortex_large_unpinned.json supplies the enlarged geometry, NbN material, two-temperature model and uniform TDGL solver.

fields.simulation_config: Larger uniform-grid reference simulation; the adaptive production solver does not use it.
fields.applied_field_T: Uniform perpendicular applied magnetic field in tesla.
fields.initial_vortex: Centered +1 vortex seed; fractional coordinates correspond to 75.5 nm on the 150 nm film.
fields.seed_position_m: Physical reference used to locate the unique vortex.
fields.laser.position_m: Fixed beam center, 15 nm in +y from the initial vortex.
fields.laser.absorbed_power_W: Absorbed power in the superconducting film.
fields.timing.exposure_steps: Short illuminated evolution used to avoid edge and long-time transport complications.
fields.output_directory: Base result directory; numbered siblings preserve prior references.
